item.description:
Location: Norwegian coast, fjords and Baltic
Description:

A Watch Officer (OOW) is sought for a self-discharging general cargo vessel operating along the Norwegian coast, fjords, and Baltic Sea. The role involves navigational watches in coastal and restricted waters, with short passages and frequent port calls. A contract duration of approximately 2 months is offered, starting in December. Candidates require sea service as OOW, 2nd, or 3rd Officer, with coastal trade experience preferred. A Norwegian pilot exemption certificate (PEC) is a strong advantage. A gross monthly salary of 3,968 EUR is offered.



Apply to this job

item.description:
Location: Offshore Indonesia
Description:

A Mooring Master position is available for operations on an FPSO offshore Indonesia. The role involves the safe and efficient mooring, connecting, offloading, and unmooring of shuttle tankers. Responsibilities include pilotage, ship handling, cargo transfer supervision, emergency response, and ensuring compliance with Indonesian regulations and international safety standards. Key requirements include extensive experience as a Mooring Master, strong leadership, and excellent communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.



Apply to this job
